title: Stop Making AI-Looking Websites With Claude Design
description:
The #1 community for building a highly-profitable personal brand with AI and Claude Code.
👉 https://www.skool.com/buildroom/

Summary ⤵️

Most people use Claude Design and end up with generic AI-generated websites.

The difference isn't the tool.

It's the workflow.

In this video, I show you how to use Claude Design to create premium, custom-looking websites by:

• Using your brand colors and assets
• Adding high-quality design references
• Writing prompts with clear creative direction
• Building responsive layouts with polished animations
• Creating websites that feel custom instead of AI-generated

If you're building client websites, landing pages, or SaaS products, this workflow can help you produce higher-quality results without starting from scratch.

Check the pinned comment for my complete Claude Design setup and workflow.

#ai #claude #claudedesign #webdesign #claudecode #aitools #nocode #webdevelopment #automation #tech
